method: 1000 seeded schedules (seeds 1..1000), each: 5 nodes, 6 clients x 30 ops on 3 keys, 800 steps of nemesis (random splits, leader isolation, crashes with and without immediate restart, leader crashes, 0-40% message loss, 1-5 tick delays with reordering), then healing. PreVote, CheckQuorum, append batch size, snapshot interval and fault frequency are randomized per seed. Raft safety invariants checked during the run; history checked with Porcupine
what: linearizability of the client-observed history under randomized faults
